example.title: Daniel Hoan Memorial Bridge (I-794 over the Milwaukee River inlet)

brief: Outlet Rd over the Kettle River. Modelled on the Hoan Bridge: a steel tied arch (185 m main span, 36.6 m clearance, 3 km long, AISC long-span award 1975) whose arch rises between the two deck halves, on long steel box-girder approaches on single concrete hammerhead piers. Here: a 185 m arch over the channel with its approaches crossing the basin. Painted as today: a golden-yellow arch over blue girders and blue railings. Foundations: pile groups 25 m below the modelled bed.
